prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Mina Castellan for the job below.

About the freelancer: 5 years experience; skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard, data cleaning, data visualization

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Accurate Data Verification
I require a freelancer skilled in data verification to ensure the highest level of accuracy (99%-100%) in converting information from paper documents into a digital format. The project will involve scrutinizing these documents closely to verify the correctness of the data before entry. **Requirements:** - Exceptional attention to detail to achieve high accuracy in data entry. - Proficiency in typing and data entry with a strong focus on speed without compromising accuracy. - Familiarity with using and navigating various digital databases and data entry platforms. - Ability to handle and organize paper documents efficiently.Hourly Range: $55.00-$80.00Posted On: February 22, 2024 19:53 UTCCategory: Data EntrySkills:Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, Data Entry, Administrative SupportSkills: Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, Data Entry, Administrative SupportLocation Requirement: Only freelancers located in the United States may apply.Country: United Statesclick to apply

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.

- Write 300 to 380 words.

text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 5 years of experience supporting data-focused tasks, and I’d love to help with your data verification project. I understand how important it is to convert paper documents into digital format with the highest possible accuracy, and I’m prepared to approach the work with the close attention to detail it requires.

My background includes SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard work, data cleaning, and data visualization, which has strengthened my ability to handle data carefully, spot inconsistencies, and maintain clean, reliable records. I’m comfortable working with digital databases and data entry platforms, and I know how important it is to balance speed with precision when accuracy is the top priority. I also have experience organizing data in structured, efficient ways so that information stays easy to review and verify.

For a project like this, I would focus on carefully comparing source documents before entering anything, checking for inconsistencies, missing details, and formatting issues along the way. I understand that your goal is not just data entry, but data verification first, and that distinction matters. I work methodically, and I take pride in producing careful, dependable work that helps reduce errors and keeps information trustworthy.

I’m also very comfortable using Excel and Google Sheets for review, cleanup, and verification tasks, and I can adapt quickly to new systems or workflows as needed. Whether the documents are straightforward or require extra scrutiny, I’m ready to stay organized and consistent throughout the process.

If selected, you can expect a reliable freelancer who values accuracy, efficiency, and clear communication. I would be glad to support your project and contribute to maintaining the highest level of data quality.

What type of paper documents will I be verifying, and are there any specific formatting or validation rules you want followed during entry?
